note: Hero origins, mortal roles and the paths that brought the hero to Rome. Ids are unique across all three lists; they are the tags used in scripts: [briton gaul] lines, ?if [gladiator], and -> scene [origin]. names are suggestions by gender. roles and paths list the fitting suggestions for an origin; most combinations stay allowed. blurb is the line shown on the creation screen. A role may list the paths that fit it (paths) and origins it is not for (notFor); a path may list origins it is not for. The creation screen only offers combinations that fit; scripts accept any.

origins.label: Roman citizen
origins.blurb: A citizen. The law, the roads and the eagles were yours before you understood them, and you have never had to ask whether you belong.

origins.label: Gaul
origins.blurb: From the lands the legions took within living memory. You know what Rome built there, and what it broke.

origins.label: Briton
origins.blurb: From the island at the edge of the world, where a great revolt was crushed only a year or two ago. Few in Rome can even say the name of your tribe.

origins.label: North African (Carthage or Numidia)
origins.blurb: From the old Punic coast or the Numidian hills, where traders and horsemen have dealt with Rome for generations.

origins.label: Egyptian
origins.blurb: From the Nile, where Rome is only the latest ruler of a country that was ancient before it began. You grew up among physicians, scribes and temples.

origins.label: Judean
origins.blurb: From a province uneasy under Roman rule, where talk of war is heard at every table. You carry your law and your city with you.

origins.label: Parthian or Persian
origins.blurb: From the empire Rome has fought for generations and never beaten. To some you are a rival, to others a useful curiosity.

origins.label: Silk Road traveler (Han China or India)
origins.blurb: A traveler from Han China or India who followed the trade roads to the far end of the world. Everything here is strange to you, and you are strange to it.

roles.label: Gladiator
roles.blurb: You fought for your life before crowds. The arena taught you what a body can bear and how to read an opponent.

roles.label: Legionary
roles.blurb: You marched under the eagles. You know drill, discipline and what an order costs the one who gives it.

roles.label: Merchant
roles.blurb: You made your living between buyers and sellers. You read people the way others read letters.

roles.label: Physician's aide
roles.blurb: You worked at a healer's side. You know wounds and fevers, and how little most cures matter.

roles.label: Slave in a noble house
roles.blurb: You served in a noble house. You know how the powerful speak when they think no one is listening.

paths.label: Born in Rome
paths.blurb: A citizen or the child of immigrants. Roman by upbringing.

paths.label: Captured in war
paths.blurb: Enslaved after Rome conquered your people.

paths.label: Freed slave
paths.blurb: Free now, but Rome still sees what you were.

paths.label: Auxiliary soldier
paths.blurb: A non citizen who served Rome for the promise of citizenship.

paths.label: Hostage
paths.blurb: A noble's child sent to guarantee your family's loyalty. Raised among Roman elites, never one of them.

paths.label: Merchant or trader
paths.blurb: You came to Rome by choice, chasing profit.

paths.label: Exile or refugee
paths.blurb: You fled war, famine or enemies, and Rome was where you landed.

paths.label: Wanderer or scholar
paths.blurb: A traveler drawn to Rome by curiosity.
